safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting denial of unwell contacts and nausea/vomiting slightly reduces completeness of the infectious/GI review but is unlikely to change management in this straightforward viral URI presentation. The main impact is minor diagnostic/contextual loss rather than a direct unsafe action.
